name: fix-this-widget
description: Standalone React feedback widget for collecting fix requests from a host app.

scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts src/metadata/elementMetadata.ts src/server.ts --format esm --dts --out-dir dist --clean --external react --external react-dom && node scripts/mark-client-entry.mjs && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs
scripts.example-simple: npm run build && rm -rf examples/example-simple/node_modules/fix-this-widget && npm --prefix examples/example-simple install && npm --prefix examples/example-simple run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.example-full: npm run build && rm -rf examples/example-full/node_modules/fix-this-widget && npm --prefix examples/example-full install && npm --prefix examples/example-full run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.examples:check: npm --prefix examples/example-simple run typecheck && npm --prefix examples/example-simple run build && npm --prefix examples/example-full run typecheck && npm --prefix examples/example-full run build
scripts.examples:audit: npm --prefix examples/example-simple audit --audit-level=high && npm --prefix examples/example-full audit --audit-level=high
scripts.check: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm pack --dry-run --json && npm run consumer-check && npm run examples:check && npm run examples:audit
